s: Din chametz sheabar alayv happesach ubo l"a seipim: chametz dagan gamur shel yisrael sheabar alayv happesach, ben sheabar alayv kol happesach uben shello abar alayv ella miqtzat happesach, apillu miqtzat yom tob haacharon shel galuyyot — hare hu asur bahanaa lekol adam miyyisrael, lepi sheqqenasuhu chakamim lebaal hechametz al sheabar alayv be"bal yeraeh" u"bal yimmatze". Velo ratzu chakamim lachaloq bigzeratam, vaasaruhu al kol adam. Velo od, ella apillu haya baal hechametz anus shello haya yakol lebaaro, o shello haya yodea mimmennu kelal ad leachar happesach, ap al pi ken asaruhu bahanaa, kede shello yanniach kol adam chametzo ad leachar happesach veyomar: "anus hayiti":

Abal chametzo shel nokri sheabar alayv happesach muttar apillu baakila im hu batzeq, o pat bemaqom shennohagin hetter bepat shel nokri, dekevan shello naasa bo abera bishhiyyato ad leachar happesach — lo asaruhu chakamim:

Nokri shehebi leyisrael doron shel chametz, apillu hebio beyom tob haacharon samuk lachasheka — lo yeqabbelennu hayyisrael miyyado, shehare beqabbala zo niqneh lo haddoron beqinyan gamur venaaseh chametzo shel yisrael, veober alayv be"bal yeraeh" u"bal yimmatze" berega zo shead hallayla. Veken lo yomar lo hayyisrael sheyyanniach haddoron bemaqom tzanua vekayyotze bidbarim kaellu shennikkar mehen shehu chapetz baddoron, sheim hu chapetz bo hu niqneh lo al yede shehu munnach bebeto o bachatzero, shekkol haddabar hammunnach bachatzero shel adam niqneh lo keillu hu munnach beyado mammash, shechatzero hu kishlucho lekol dabar. Abal kesheen nikkar mittok debarayv o maasayv shehu chapetz behaddoron — en chatzero qona lo, lepi shemmin hassetam en noach leadam liqnot lo dabar haasur lo liqnoto, vekevan sheen noach lo liqnoto en chatzero naaseh kishlucho liqnot lo dabar sheen noach lo, sheen adam naaseh shaliach lachabero baal korcho:

Umikkol maqom, tob lehachamir uleparesh bepiv sheeno rotzeh sheyyiqneh lo chatzero et haddoron shel hannokri. Vetzarik lizzaher likpot alayv et hakkeli ad haereb im hu shabbat o yom tob, apillu yom tob haacharon, kemo shennitbaer besiman t"m, ella im ken hebio beyom tob haacharon samuk lachasheka, shebbeshaa muetet en lachosh shemma yishkach veyoklennu. Veim hu chol hammoed tzarik laasot lepanayv mechitztza gaboah y' tepachim, kemo shennitbaer sham, ayyen sham kol perate din zeh:

Vekol zeh bedoron vekayyotze bo sheen haacharayut al hayyisrael im yigganeb hechametz o yobad, abal im hannokri mebi lebet hayyisrael limkor o lehapqid etzlo — tzarik hayyisrael lomar beperush lehannokri sheeno rotzeh leqabbelo kede shello yitchayyeb beacharayuto kelal, velo yukal hannokri likpoto leshallem ap im hu allam. Veim eno allam veen hekreach kelal leyisrael sheyyeqabbel piqdono — lo yannichennu sheyyanniach hechametz birshuto bekol inyan, ella im ken hu samuk lachasheka beyom tob haacharon, ayyen siman t"m:

Yisrael sheyyesh lo chametz harbeh beereb pesach verotzeh lemokro lenokri hammakkiro umeyuddao o litteno lo bemattana, ap al pi shehu yodea behannokri shello yigga bachametzo kelal ella yishmerennu lo ad leachar happesach veaz yachazirennu lo — hare zeh muttar, dekevan sheim lo haya hannokri rotzeh lehachaziro lo lo haya yakol litboa mimmennu bedin sheyyachazirennu lo im kebar qanahu hannokri beechad middarke haqqeniyya sheyyitbaer, nimtza shekkol yeme happesach hechametz qanuy lehannokri beqinyan gamur, veachar happesach shehu machaziro lo — mattana hu shehu noten lo:

Umikkol maqom, tzarik lizzaher shello yimkerennu veyittenennu leabdo haqqanuy lo litzmitut, ap al pi shehu dar michutz lebet hayyisrael umoshek et hechametz mereshut hayyisrael lirshuto, ap al pi ken en hechametz qanuy lo kelal, shekkol mah sheqqana ebed qana rabbo. Abal im en gup haebed qanuy lo litzmitut ella shehu sakir etzlo — muttar lemokro lo velitteno lo ap al pi shehu dar bebet hayyisrael. Ubilbad sheyyimshok hannokri et hechametz mereshut hayyisrael lirshuto o lirshut shel hepqer, kede sheyyiqneh et hechametz bimshika zo. Vaapillu im qana hannokri et hechametz beechad mishshear darke haqqeniyyot sheyyitbaaru, ap al pi ken, im epshar tob hu sheyyotzi hannokri et hechametz mereshut hayyisrael qodem happesach, sheim yishshaer hechametz munnach birshut hayyisrael — yehe nireh keillu qibbel hayyisrael et hechametz bepiqqadon miyyad hannokri, veacharayut happiqqadon al yisrael. Abal meiqqar haddin en lachosh lazeh. Umikkol maqom, im hu beinyan sheim lo yotziennu hannokri mereshut hayyisrael yitchayyeb hayyisrael beacharayuto, dehaynu sheim yigganeb mimmennu hechametz o yobad yitchayyeb lehachazir lehannokri deme hammekira shennatan lo beet qeniyyato mimmennu et hechametz — tzarik hayyisrael lehazhir et hannokri sheyyotzi et hechametz mereshuto, kede shello yitchayyeb lehachazir lo damayv im yigganeb mimmennu o yobad:

Umikkol maqom, ap al pi shehotzi hannokri et hechametz mereshut hayyisrael lirshuto o lirshut shel hepqer, ap al pi ken lekattechilla tzarik sheyyittol mimmennu hayyisrael kesep o sheveh kesep kepi shivvuy kol hammiqqach shel kol hechametz beshaar shebbashshuq, o sheyyiqqach mimmennu meat kesep o sheveh kesep, ubead hashshear yaamid lo areb qabbelan bead kol hammaot sheyyeshallem lo lizman peraon sheqqaba lo beinyan shello yihyeh lo shum taana umaaneh al hannokri bead hammaot ki im al heareb qabbelan, lepi sheyyesh omerim shehannokri eno qoneh mittaltelin bimshika ella bekesep. Abal bediabad shello qana hannokri et hechametz ella bimshika bilbad o bekesep bilbad veabar alayv happesach — hare zeh muttar apillu baakila. Veken im nizkar leachar shehiggia shaa shishshit, sheaz eno yakol lehaqnoto lenokri kemo shennitbaer besiman tm"g — en tzarik lipdoto mehannokri ulebaaro min haolam. Veap al pi sheyyesh omerim shehannokri eno qoneh mittaltelin bekesep bilbad ella bimshika, kemo shennitbaer bechoshen mishpat siman qtz"d, vezeh shello mashak et hechametz mereshut hayyisrael lo qanahu kelal ap al pi shennatan lo kol damayv, vahare hu chametzo shel yisrael, mikkol maqom (hare yesh omerim shehannokri qoneh mittaltelin apillu bekesep bilbad o bimshika bilbad, kemo shennitbaer beyoreh dea siman ql"b, veyesh lismok al dibrehem lehaqel bechametz sheabar alayv happesach sheeno asur ella middibre soperim, shebbedibre soperim hallek achar hammeqel, veod) kevan shehechametz leachar shehiggia zeman biuro ap im lo haya mokero lenokri lo haya birshuto shel hayyisrael velo niqra shello kelal, shehare en rashshay lehanot mimmennu, ella shehattora heemida et hechametz birshuto lihyot shemo niqra alayv sheyyaabor alayv be"bal yeraeh" u"bal yimmatze" im lo hotzio mereshuto qodem shehiggia zeman habbiur velo biaro min haolam leachar shehiggia zeman habbiur, lepikak begilluy daat bilbad shehu megalleh dato qodem shehiggia zeman habbiur sheen retzono kelal sheyyihyeh hechametz shello day bazeh lehapqia mealayv issur "bal yeraeh" u"bal yimmatze", vegilluy daat zeh hu mah shemmaqneh oto lannokri, ap al pi sheeno qinyan gamur hammoil middin tora shello yukal echad mehen lachazor bo ulebattel hammiqqach:

Vekol zeh keshemmoker chametzo, abal im noteno bemattana lenokri — en tzarik ella meshika bilbad ledibre hakkol, shello ameru sheqqinyano shel nokri hu bekesep ella bemeker, shehannokri tzarik litten kesep miqnato lehammoker ubazeh niqneh lo hammeker, abal bemattana sheen sham kesep miqneh day bimshika bilbad:

Im oto hannokri shehu maqneh lo chametzo lo mashak beatzmo et hechametz mereshut hayyisrael, ella tzivva leyisrael acher o lenokri acher sheyyabi lo et hechametz mereshut hayyisrael — en zeh kelum, mippene sheen omerim shelucho shel adam kemoto ella beyisrael shennaaseh shaliach leyisrael, kemo shennitbaer bechoshen mishpat siman qp"ch:

Lepikak, im haya hechametz rab shei epshar lehannokri beatzmo lehotzi et kullo mereshut hayyisrael qodem happesach, veken im en hannokri rotzeh lehotzio mereshut hayyisrael, veken im en hechametz kan etzel hayyisrael sheyyukal hannokri lemoshko, kegon shehu beir acheret o al hadderek — tzarik lehaqnoto lehannokri beechad mishshear darke haqqeniyya shehen qinyan gamur hammoil shello yukal echad mehen lachazor bo, kegon bekol dabar shennahagu hassocharim liqnot bo, dehaynu al yede haroshem shennahagu biqtzat meqomot shekkeshehalloqeach roshem al hammiqqach kede sheyyihyeh lo siman yadua shehu qanuy lo qinyan gamur, o al yede teqiat kap, o al yede netinat peruta bimqomot shennohagin shekkeshehalloqeach noten peruta lammoker, o shemmakkin bekappehen zeh al gabbe zeh — nigmar hammiqqach veen echad mehem yakol lachazor bo. O al yede sheyyimsor hayyisrael lehannokri et hammapteach min hacheder shehechametz munnach betoko im hu bemaqom shennohagin shemmesirat hammapteach qona qinyan gamur. O al yede aggab qarqa, dehaynu sheyyimkor lehannokri gam hacheder shehechametz munnach betoko, veyomar: "aggab hacheder tizkeh hechametz shebbetoko", abal im eno omer kallashon hazzeh, ap al pi shemmittechilla makar lo et hacheder veachar kak makar lo et hechametz shebbetoko — en hechametz niqneh lehannokri al yede shehu munnach bechadro shel nokri, shello ameru chatzero shel adam qona lo ella beyisrael, shehechatzer hu kishlucho ushelucho shel yisrael kemoto, abal en shelucho shel nokri kemoto, kemo shennitbaer:

Keshemmoker lehannokri et hacheder — tzarik sheyyittol mehannokri kesep o sheveh kesep bead kol deme hammekira, o sheyyiqqach meat kesep o sheveh kesep ubead hashshear yaamid lo areb qabbelan sheyyeshallem lo lizman peraon sheqqaba lehannokri. Vegam yiktob lo shetar mekira, sheen hannokri qoneh qarqa lo bekesep bilbad velo bachazaqa, ella bishtar im hakkesep, kemo shennitbaer bechoshen mishpat siman qtz"d (veayyen sham besiman qtz"a haek yiktob leshon hammekira bishtar). Ak kol ish asher yirat Hashem naga belibbo latzet yede kol haddeot bimkirat chametz shettihyeh mekira gemura ledibre hakkol — yiktob hashshetar mekira kannosach hakkatub bassiddur:

Apillu im hiqna et hechametz lehannokri beechad mishshear darke haqqeniyya velo makar lo et hacheder, ap al pi ken tzarik limsor lehannokri et hammapteach min hacheder shehechametz munnach betoko, kede sheyyukal hannokri likkanes lehacheder velittol et chametzo bekol et sheyyirtzeh mikkol yeme happesach. Veken tzarik lizzaher shello yanniach hayyisrael et chotamo al hechametz kede sheyyira hannokri littol min hechametz kelum shello middaat hayyisrael. Vaapillu bediabad asur hechametz bahanaa leachar happesach im lo masar lo et hammapteach qodem shaa shishshit, o shehinniach chotamo al hechametz qodem mekirato o bishat mekirato, dekevan shebbishat mekira gilla hayyisrael dato lehannokri sheen retzono sheyyittol hannokri et hechametz mereshut hayyisrael shello middato — hare lo makar lo kelum, veen zeh ella haarama beolma. Abal im makar lo hechametz kedino bimsirat hammapteach veachar kak hinniach hayyisrael chotamo al hechametz, ap sheasur laasot ken, vetzarik limchot beyad haoseh ken, mikkol maqom bediabad lo neesar hechametz leachar happesach, dekevan shemmakar hechametz lehannokri kedino — miyyad niqna hechametz lehannokri qinyan gamur, vahare hu keshello mammash, veap sheachar kak chatamo hayyisrael bechotamo lo yatza hechametz mereshut hannokri al yede kak, vahare zeh keillu chatam et hechametz shehu shel nokri mammash, velo haya lehayyisrael cheleq uzekut bo meolam, shebbevadday lo neesar hechametz bishbil kak, ki kol emat umatay shehannokri rotzeh hu mesir et hachotam venotel min hechametz kol mah sheyyirtzeh:

(Abal im leachar shemmasar et hammapteach lannokri bishat mekira chazar unetalo mimmennu beal korcho kede shello yikkanes hannokri letok hacheder veyittol kelum mehechametz — hare chametz zeh leachar happesach asur bahanaa lekol adam miyyisrael, dekevan shello hinniach et hannokri likkanes letok hacheder shehechametz munnach sham — hare niptar hannokri meacharayut hechametz, sheim yigganeb mishsham hechametz chal hahepsed al hayyisrael, dehaynu shello yitztarek hannokri leshallem lo chobo shechayyab lo bead hechametz shemmakar lo, vekol chametz sheyyaggia mimmennu hepsed leyisrael im yigganeb o yobad — ober alayv yisrael be"bal yeraeh" u"bal yimmatze", uleachar happesach hu asur bahanaa kachametzo mammash sheabar alayv happesach, kemo shennitbaer besiman t"m):

Tzarik lehazhir lahamon am sheyyomru lehannokri: "hareni moker leka et kol hechametz sheyyesh li", velo yomar lo: "hareni moker leka et hammapteach", shezzeh eno kelum, vaapillu bediabad asur hechametz bahanaa leachar happesach, shehare lo mekaro kelal:

Ereb pesach shechal beshabbat veshakach velo makar chametzo lenokri beereb shabbat — lo yimkerennu lenokri beshabbat, apillu eno loqeach mimmennu maot kelal ella qotzetz immo sekum hammiqqach o mokero lo keshaar shebbashshuq belo qetzitzat sekum miqqach umaqneh lo hechametz beechad middarke haqqeniyya — hare zeh asur apillu bimqom hepsed merubbeh. Ap al pi shemmekira zo hi letzorek mitzvat biur chametz — lo hittiruha chakamim beshabbat, kemo shennitbaer besiman sh"v, shemmiqqach umimkar gamur lo hittiru apillu letzorek mitzva, ayyen sham. Ella ketzad yaaseh? Yittenennu bemattana gemura lenokri hammakkiro umeyuddao, shehu yodea bo sheyyachazirennu lo leachar happesach, veyizzaher lehaqnot lo hechametz behagbaha o bimshika sheyyimshekennu hannokri lirshuto im en tzarik lehaabiro derek reshut harabbim, kemo shennitbaer besiman tm"d ayyen sham. Veim hechametz rab shei epshar lemoshko — yizzaher lehaqnot lo bimsirat hammapteach. Veap al pi sheasur litten mattana beshabbat, mikkol maqom letzorek mitzva hittiru, kemo shennitbaer besiman sh"v, ayyen sham:

Rashshay yisrael lomar lenokri beshaa h' beereb pesach o qodem: "ad sheatta loqeach chametz minnokri o miyyisrael acher bemaneh, qach mimmenni bematayim, veeqqachennu mimmeka leachar happesach veachazir leka maoteka, veosip leka od revach al zeh". Veap al pi shehannokri hu mukrach lehachazir lo hechametz leachar happesach, shehare laqach mimmennu beyoter mikkede shovyo, mikkol maqom kevan shekkebar makar lo et hechametz bimkira gemura vehiqna lo beqinyan gamur — hare hu keshello mammash kol zeman shello chazar hayyisrael uleqacho mimmennu:

Ap al pi shebbekol hattora kullah hannoten mattana al menat sheyyachazirenna lo leachar zeman hare hi mattana gemura vahare hi keshello mammash betok hazzeman, mikkol maqom leinyan chametz bepesach hechemiru chakamim veaseru litten hechametz bemattana lenokri al menat sheyyachaziro lo leachar happesach. Vaapillu im eno omer lannokri: "al menat shettachaziro li", ella noteno lo veomer lo: "reeh shettachaziro li leachar happesach, veap im lo tachaziro li hare hu shelleka bemattana gemura kol yeme happesach", ap al pi ken kevan shehu omer lehannokri beperush sheyyachaziro lo, hechemiru bo chakamim mechamat chumrat chametz, veen lilmod mikkan limqomot acherim:

Vaapillu litten o limkor al tenay, kegon sheamar lo: "hareni mokero o noteno leka bemattana lachalutin meakshav al menat shettaaseh dabar peloni betok happesach o leachar happesach", ap al pi shekkesheyyaaseh hannokri oto dabar bazzeman sheqqaba lo nimtza shellemaprea haya hechametz shello miqqodem happesach, mikkol maqom lekattechilla asur laasot ken, veyesh kan sepeq issur shel tora, shemma lo yaaseh hannokri oto dabar bazzeman sheqqaba, venimtza shellemaprea lo niqna hechametz lannokri meolam, vahare zeh kachametzo shel yisrael hammupqad beyad nokri sheober alayv hayyisrael be"bal yeraeh" u"bal yimmatze", kemo shennitbaer besiman t"m:

Abal im lo amar lo "meakshav", ella netano lo bistam, veamar lo: "im taaseh dabar peloni betok happesach o leachar happesach yihyeh hechametz shelleka", ap al pi sheasa hannokri oto dabar bazzeman sheqqaba lo, ap al pi ken lo niqna lo hechametz ella meoto zeman vaelak, veqodem oto zeman haya hechametz kemupqad beyad hannokri, veabar alayv hayyisrael be"bal yeraeh" u"bal yimmatze". Ulepikak chametz zeh leachar happesach asur bahanaa, veasur lekol adam miyyisrael liqnoto min hannokri:

Veken im amar lo: "hareni mokero leka al menat shettachazirehu li kesheyyihyeh li damim lipdoto mimmeka" — en zo mekira kelal, ap im natan lo hannokri kol deme hechametz, shehare bekol yom vayom mime happesach im yabo hayyisrael lipdot chametzo en hannokri yakol leakkeb al yado, nimtza sheen hechametz qanuy lehannokri kelal veeno keshello mammash, ulepikak chametz zeh leachar happesach asur bahanaa, shehare abar alayv hayyisrael be"bal yeraeh" u"bal yimmatze":

Abal im amar lo: "al menat shettachazirehu li leachar happesach", kevan shekkol yeme happesach lo haya mechuyyab lehachaziro lehayyisrael — hare hu keshello mammash kol yeme happesach, ulepikak leachar happesach hu muttar apillu baakila, kevan shello abar alayv hayyisrael be"bal yeraeh" u"bal yimmatze", ella shellekattechilla asur laasot ken kemo shennitbaer:

Abal muttar lomar lo lekattechilla: "hareni mokero leka bimkira gemura lachalutin, abal zekut zeh shiyyarti li bo sheim tirtzeh lemokro lo timkerennu leshum adam chutz mimmenni". Vetob shekkol adam hammoker chametzo lenokri yomar lo ken beperush, veyoil bazeh sheshshum adam chutz mimmennu lo yukal liqnot chametzo min hannokri leachar happesach. Umikkol maqom, ap im lo amar lo ken beperush — en shum adam yakol liqnoto min hannokri, shebbevadday hayeta dato ken keshemmakar lannokri sheyyishshaer lo zekut zeh bachametzo sheshshum adam lo yukal liqnoto min hannokri:

Abal lo yatneh im hannokri bishat mekira she"al menat ken ani moker leka shello timkerennu leshum adam chutz mimmenni", shemma yaabor hannokri al tenay zeh veyimkerennu leadam acher, venimtza shellemaprea lo haya hechametz qanuy lehannokri meolam, veabar alayv hayyisrael be"bal yeraeh" u"bal yimmatze", veyeesor hechametz bahanaa:

Im en hannokri rotzeh lehachazir lo hechametz leachar happesach ella rotzeh lehachaziqo leatzmo uleshallem damayv leyisrael — asur litboa oto bedinehem o lekuppo bishar kepiyyot ad sheyyachazirennu lo, shehare kebar nimkar lo lachalutin:

En limkor et hechametz lemumar, sheap al pi shechata yisrael hu, vachametzo sheabar alayv happesach asur bahanaa kachametzo shel yisrael. Veim abar umakar lo chametzo bedabar muat mippene shehu makkiro veyodea bo sheyyachazirennu lo leachar happesach, shello haya yodea shehechametz yehe asur bahanaa, im yesh hepsed merubbeh baddabar — yesh lehattir lo sheyyomar lehammumar sheyyachalip et hechametz im nokri al chametz acher o al dabar acher, o sheyyimkerennu lenokri, vehachalipin o hammaot muttarin leyisrael, kemo shennitbaer besiman tm"g ayyen sham:

Yisrael venokri shehaya lahem shuttaput bechametz veabar alayv happesach, ap al pi shehachetzi shel yisrael neesar bahanaa vehu meorab im hachetzi shel hannokri, ap al pi ken kesheyyachaloqu achar happesach hare hachetzi shel nokri muttar apillu baakila vechetzi shel yisrael asur apillu bahanaa:

Yisrael shehaya lo bebet harechayim tebua sheenah mechummetzet letachanah qodem happesach velo nitchana ad shehiggia happesach sheaz tachanah hannokri baal harechayim veapa mimmenna pat uleachar happesach hebi et happat leyisrael leharot lo tobato — muttar leyisrael liqqach damim min hannokri bead hattebua, veen zeh neheneh mechametz sheabar alayv happesach, lepi shehannokri beshaa sheasa mimmenna issa vechimmetzah hare zeh keillu serapah, shehare enah reuya od lehayyisrael, veqodem shechimmetzah hayeta adayin mutteret layyisrael, im ken deme hetter hu meqabbel min hannokri. Veen mechayyebin et hayyisrael liqqach happat min hannokri ulebaaro min haolam kede shello yimkerennu hannokri leyisrael acher sheeno yodea shehu chametz shel yisrael sheabar alayv happesach veyoklennu, lepi sheen hayyisrael mechuyyab lehapsid mamono mippene taqqalat acherim, kevan shehu eno noten lipnehem taqqala, shehare eno moker hechametz lehannokri, ella hannokri meshallem lo nizqo, umimmela nishar hechametz lehannokri, ayyen siman t"m:

Chametz hannimtza birshut yisrael leachar happesach miyyad veyadua sheabar alayv happesach, ap al pi shebbadaq belel y"d ketaqqanat chakamim ubittel kol chametzo shennishar birshuto shello metzao babbediqa, venimtza shello abar be"bal yeraeh" u"bal yimmatze" apillu middibre soperim al chametz zeh shennimtza birshuto leachar happesach, ap al pi ken hu asur bahanaa, apillu yesh lo edim shebbittel kol chametzo o shehipqiro bipnehem bilshon hepqer mammash, sheim yehe muttar bahanaa yesh lachosh shemma yanniach kol adam chametzo ad leachar happesach veyomar shehipqiro qodem happesach kede shennattir lo lehanot mimmennu. Vaapillu chametz shennimtza mushlak bimqom hepqer, shehishliko sham yisrael qodem shaa shishshit beereb pesach kede shello yaabor alayv be"bal yeraeh" u"bal yimmatze" bepesach, kemo shennitbaer besiman tm"h, shemmuttar laasot ken lekattechilla, mikkol maqom leachar happesach asur lekol adam miyyisrael lehanot mimmennu:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesheyyadua shehu shel yisrael, o sherob obere maqom hahu hen yisrael, shemmin hassetam napal shamma min harob, abal im rob obere maqom hahu hen nokrim, o apillu mechetza al mechetza — tolin lehaqel lomar shemmin nokri napal shamma, umuttar apillu baakila, shekkol sepeq dibre soperim lehaqel. Vekol zeh keshennimtza miyyad leachar happesach, shei epshar litlot shennapal shamma leachar happesach, abal im epshar litlot shennapal shamma leachar happesach — muttar baakila bekol inyan, apillu nimtza betok beto shel yisrael, shekkol sepeq dibre soperim lehaqel. Lepikak, yesh lehattir liqnot min hammumar achar happesach shekar veyen-sarap ushear chametz im yesh litlot shennaasa achar happesach velo abar alayv apillu miqtzat happesach. Veyesh machamirin bekol sepeq chametz sheabar alayv happesach leosro baakila. Veyesh lachosh ledibrehem bemaqom sheen sham hepsed merubbeh. Abal bahanaa muttar ledibre hakkol:
Chametz shel yisrael sheabar alayv happesach — asur lehaakilo apillu libhemot nokrim o shel hepqer, kemo shennitbaer besiman tm"g leinyan chametz bepesach, ayyen sham:
